text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Having run a splendid race, Zenno Rob Roy 
began writing her own story with her own 
legs.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
She declares her intention to follow the 
royal road of the Classic Triple Crown—the 
Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Reach beyond the royal road and become an 
ideal hero. To do so requires steady 
experience and proven results. Such was 
the logical conclusion.
